newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria budgets $200 million for oil refineries.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria budgets $200 million for oil refineries.

text.p: Nigeria has set aside $200 million for expenditure on its four oil refineries, finance minister Anthony Ani said in his detailed breakdown of the 1997 budget on Monday.
"A total of $300 million has been budgeted for the Nigerian National Petroleum Corp (NNPC), of which $200 million will be spent on refineries," Ani said.
Nigeria's four refineries currently process about 250,000 barrels per day (bpd) from a theoretical capacity of 445,000 bpd.
The manager of the largest refinery, Port Harcourt, told Reuters last month they hoped to receive $250 million from the government for essential repairs and maintenance in 1997.
